summary: Iteration 24 (backend-only retest): Verified the 2 HIGH-priority fixes from iteration_23. Updated /app/backend/tests/test_admin_documents.py to target the new admin prefix /admin/document-vault and to explicitly assert /vault/verify accepts a body WITHOUT document_id. 18/18 tests pass. Both admin_document_routes and document_master_routes /stats endpoints are now reachable independently, and the AdminVerificationQueue Approve/Reject payload no longer 422s.

minor.issue: Still uses List[str] + str + Optional[str] as raw function params (mix of body + query). Works but fragile — carry-over from iter23. Consider consolidating into a single Pydantic BulkVerifyRequest.
N+1 users.find_one + operators.find_one per document during owner enrichment. Fine at current scale; use $lookup or a batched dict for larger queues.
File bytes still base64-encoded into document_files.content instead of services.storage_service (same as /new-version). Not part of this iteration's fix but still open.

critical_code_review_comments: Fix confirmed: admin_document_routes now mounts at /admin/document-vault, eliminating the shadowing bug against document_master_routes /admin/documents/stats. Both routers coexist and both /stats endpoints return their intended schemas.

Fix confirmed: DocumentVerification.document_id is now Optional, so POST /api/vault/verify/{document_id} accepts the exact JSON payload the UI sends ({verification_status, verified_by, verification_notes}) and returns 200. Backward-compatible when the client also includes document_id in the body.
Minor: /admin/document-vault/bulk-verify still exposes primitive body params without an explicit Pydantic model — cosmetic, not blocking.

context_for_next_testing_agent: iter23 HIGH-priority defects are fully resolved and covered by regression tests: (a) test_stats_admin_new_schema hits /admin/document-vault/stats and asserts by_status/by_category; (b) test_document_master_stats_still_works asserts the original /admin/documents/stats still returns the document_master shape (document_types/verification_apis/verifications); (c) test_vault_verify_without_document_id_in_body posts the exact UI payload and expects 200. Frontend Approve/Reject UI change was not manually re-tested here (backend-only scope) — main agent can self-verify in the AdminVerificationQueue tab; the underlying API contract is now correct.
rca_of_the_issue: Root causes from iter23 are addressed at the correct layer: (1) route shadowing eliminated by giving admin_document_routes a distinct prefix (/admin/document-vault) rather than relying on registration order; (2) Pydantic contract mismatch eliminated by making DocumentVerification.document_id Optional, so the path parameter is the single source of truth while the body remains permissive for existing callers.
